0022600137.text: The Bulls (1-3, 0-1 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the New York Knicks (1-3, on a one-game winning streak) in Chicago's fifth game of the season, with Chicago 4th in the Central and 11th in the East and New York 4th in the Atlantic and 12th in the East, both two games back. Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (hamstring, out), while Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and New York will be without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain, out). The teams have not met yet this season, and in the 2025-26 season series the Bulls lost 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
